steps.en: Add the dependency — it needs nothing beyond the standard library
steps.zh: 加上依赖，它除了标准库什么都不要

steps.en: Call it once at program start
steps.zh: 在程序启动时调用一次

steps.en: On a Windows console, turns on built-in ANSI support, or on old Windows wraps stdout/stderr to translate codes
steps.zh: 在 Windows 上打开控制台自带的 ANSI 支持，老版本则代为翻译

steps.en: Print colored text with its constants or any ANSI-emitting library
steps.zh: 用它的常量或任何输出 ANSI 的库打印彩色文字

steps.en: Colors render on Windows; on Linux/macOS it does nothing and the codes pass through untouched
steps.zh: Windows 上正常显示颜色；Linux/macOS 上它不插手，原样放行

value.en: One code path prints colored text on every OS, with no platform branch and no third-party dependency
value.zh: 一条代码路径在所有系统上都能打出彩色文字，不用按平台分支，也不引第三方依赖

sources: https://github.com/tartley/colorama#installation (pip install colorama; no requirements other than the standard library)

https://github.com/tartley/colorama#initialisation (just_fix_windows_console(): Windows 10+ flips the built-in ANSI switch, older Windows wraps sys.stdout/sys.stderr and issues Win32 calls, other platforms nothing)
https://github.com/tartley/colorama#colored-output (print(Fore.RED + 'some red text'); use with termcolor / blessings / rich)
